events_list.title:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/workspace')
payments=json.loads((base/'payments.json').read_text())['payments']
invoices=json.loads((base/'invoices.json').read_text())['invoices']
recon=json.loads((base/'reconciliation.json').read_text())
pids={p['payment_id'] for p in payments}
iids={i['invoice_id'] for i in invoices}
assert set(recon)==pids, (set(recon), pids)
assert set(recon.values())==iids, (set(recon.values()), iids)
assert len(recon)==6 and len(set(recon.values()))==6
print(json.dumps(recon, indent=2))
print('VALID: 6/6 payments and 6/6 invoices, one-to-one')
PY"
